metadata.title: Change Management

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for governing how changes to device software, configuration, or operational state are introduced, tracked, and bounded.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Embedded software, firmware, device configuration, calibration parameters, and operational state transitions.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Foundational Zero Trust pattern defining how device changes are controlled, observable, and attributable, independent of safety or authorization.

props.name: data-pattern
props.remarks: Defines device change events and state transitions as auditable trust‑relevant signal data.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Defines baseline expectations for managing device software and configuration updates.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Guidance on device update mechanisms, rollback, and state visibility.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Zero Trust guidance asserting that change introduces new risk and must be explicitly governed.

metadata.remarks: Change Management defines how modifications to a device are introduced and tracked across its lifecycle. This pattern does not approve changes, assert safety, authorize operators, or determine mission suitability.

components.title: Change Classification
components.description: Classification of device changes by type, scope, and impact.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Changes are distinguishable by type and scope.

components.title: Change Attribution
components.description: Ability to attribute changes to a specific identity, process, or automation.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Device changes are attributable for audit and analysis.

components.title: Change State Management
components.description: Explicit lifecycle state transitions during modification, update, or maintenance.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Device state during change is explicitly managed and observable.

components.title: Change Observability
components.description: Visibility into when and how device changes occur.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Device changes are logged and observable.

components.title: Change Management Non‑Equivalence Constraints
components.description: Explicitly defines what a valid or tracked change does not grant or imply.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Change approval does not imply safety, authorization, or mission approval.
